cues.en: The non local keyword is used to refer to this part, this parent local.
cues.zh: nonlocal 用來指向這一層，也就是外層函式的區域作用域。

cues.en: It's a way for us to say, Hey, I want to use a variable that is not a global variable but is outside of the scope of my function.

cues.zh: 取代原本的 'local'。印出 inner 的 x，得到 nonlocal；再印

cues.en: Again, I argue that this actually makes your code more complicated than it needs to be.
cues.zh: 我認為，這可能讓程式變得不必要地複雜。

cues.en: So there are special cases where you might want to use this, but if you can try to make your code predictable where you can avoid using things like non-local and global.
cues.zh: 特殊情況可能需要，但可以的話，讓程式可預測，盡量避免 nonlocal 和 global。

cues.en: Mind you, they are there for a reason because they are useful in some situation.
